[空船船員]: Joker 說你借給他錢，他會用更多錢還你。你應該拒絕，對吧？但 Joker 的誘惑不只一次。

[Airship Crew]: He will linger around you as a neighbor, or a rare item and ask for money.
[空船船員]: 他會像鄰居或稀有物品一樣纏著你，向你借錢。

[Airship Crew]: Act wisely! You'll be in trouble you are tricked easily!
[空船船員]: 行事要明智！若輕易中計，你就會陷入麻煩！

[Airship Crew]: Even a joker asks for change, never give any to him. He will ask for change, then end up ask for a big sum of money.
[空船船員]: 連 Joker 都要零錢，千萬別給他。他先要零錢，最後卻要一大筆錢。

[Airship Crew]: Jokers are like that. They have the ability to turn a small mistake into a big calamity.
[空船船員]: Joker 就是這樣。他們有能力將小錯誤變成大災難。

[Airship Crew]: That's why you should be more careful about it.
There is only one reason a Joker requests money.. to take yours.
[空船船員]: Joker 借錢只有一個原因……就是要拿走你的錢。

[Airship Crew]: His goal is not to become rich. A real foul playful one.
[空船船員]: 他的目的不是變富。他是個真正的惡作劇者。

[Airship Crew]: But losing money isn't a joke now, is it? You should be careful.
[空船船員]: 但現在失錢可不是玩笑，對吧？你應小心。

[Airship Crew]: Hodes do not know about money. They just gobble everything up. But that might be the shortcut to gaining great wealth.
[空船船員]: Hode 不懂錢。他們只是貪吃一切。但這或許是致富的捷徑。

[Airship Crew]: Don't focus too much on money. Just work at it. It's saying that it is the best method.
[空船船員]: 別太在意錢。只要努力去做，這就是最好的方法。

[Airship Crew]: Hodes do not know anything about money. But they do not forgive those who have an eye on their things.
[空船船員]: Hode 不懂錢，但他們不會饒恕那些觊觎他們東西的人。

[Airship Crew]: Not being greedy and taking care of your share is the wisest way to manage your wealth.
[空船船員]: 不貪心且妥善管理你的份額，才是管理財富最明智的方式。

[Airship Crew]: Indeed, the Hode is right. Do you understand as well?
[空船船員]: 沒錯，Hode 說得對。你也明白嗎？

[Airship Crew]: The Hode knows nothing about money. But a very rare item drops from a Hode's body.
[空船船員]: Hode 不懂錢，但從他們身上掉落的稀有物品極為罕見。

[Airship Crew]: It has a treasure in it without knowing.
[空船船員]: 裡面藏著寶藏，卻不自知。

[Airship Crew]: Take a careful look around you. Treasures are hidden all over.
[空船船員]: 仔細環顧四周。寶藏藏處處處皆有。

[Airship Crew]: Hodes are strong even though they live in the desert. Just because the environment is poor, doesn't mean that you can't gather wealth.
[空船船員]: Hode 雖住在沙漠，卻很強壯。環境貧瘠，不代表你不能累積財富。

[Airship Crew]: Don't blame the environment. That excuse is only for whiners.
[空船船員]: 別怪環境。那只是抱怨者的藉口。

[Airship Crew]: Do you know the saying that says those who work like bulls become rich? Working hard is the best way.
[空船船員]: 你知道那句老話嗎？「像牛一樣努力工作的人就會致富」。努力就是最好的方法。

[Airship Crew]: Bulls only know how to work, but the bull itself has a lot to offer. Meat, leather, horn..
[空船船員]: 牛只知道工作，但牛本身也有許多價值：肉、皮革、角……

[Airship Crew]: You, too, should look after yourself and not just work. You have many hidden values.
[空船船員]: 你也應照顧自己，不只是工作。你擁有許多隱藏的價值。

[Airship Crew]: Bulls continue to work even on gloomy days. Then they can gather a lot of things.
[空船船員]: 牛即使在陰天也繼續工作，這樣就能累積許多東西。

[Airship Crew]: Don't be picky about the days you work. You will be able to make more money.
[空船船員]: 別挑日子工作。這樣你才能賺到更多錢。

[Airship Crew]: Bulls do not like working for money. They are disgruntled when others consider labor as money.
[空船船員]: 牛不喜歡為錢工作。若別人將勞動視為金錢，牠們會不悅。

[Airship Crew]: Shouldn't you reconsider working against your will just for money?
[空船船員]: 為了錢而違背意願地工作，你不應該重新考慮一下嗎？

[Airship Crew]: It is a serious problem. It is your life, so ponder about it young one.
[空船船員]: 這是嚴重問題。這是你的生命，年輕人，好好想想。

[Airship Crew]: Most people are curious about money.
It is a very humanly and common curiosity. Cards are very stingy about fortunes regarding wealth.
[空船船員]: 這是非常人性且常見的疑問。關於財富的運勢，神牌極為吝嗇。

[Airship Crew]: Therefore, getting a fortune like this is considered being lucky. Use this fortune to prosper.
[空船船員]: 因此，獲得這樣的運勢視為幸運。善用這份運勢來繁榮。

[Airship Crew]: Future... the card that sees the future is beginning to speak...... Prepare yourself...
[空船船員]: 未來……預知未來的神牌開始說話……準備自己……

[Airship Crew]: Youth is not eternal. At one point when you wake up, you realize you are already a middle-aged worker.
[空船船員]: 青春並非永恆。當你醒來時，可能會發現自己已經是中年上班族了。

[Airship Crew]: Even reminiscing about the past over a cup of coffee can't bring back time.
[空船船員]: 即使回憶往昔，一杯咖啡也無法喚回逝去的光陰。

[Airship Crew]: Treasure the present.. is what the card is saying.
[空船船員]: 卡片上說的是：珍惜當下。

[Airship Crew]: This fortune is foreshadowing that you will become a strong and healthy worker in the future.
[空船船員]: 這份運勢預示你未來會成為強壯健康的上班族。

[Airship Crew]: Not a normal worker, but one that has great strength and might..
[空船船員]: 不是普通上班族，而是擁有強大力量與威勢的人……

[Airship Crew]: You should prepare for your future.
Smoking in a mine is an imprudent, life-threatening thing to do. You are wasting your precious life with that kind of behavior.
[空船船員]: 在礦坑抽菸是愚蠢且危及生命的行為。你正浪費寶貴的生命。

[Airship Crew]: Act with a little more wisdom for your future.
[空船船員]: 為未來多些智慧，行動吧。

[Airship Crew]: You may be shoveling in the future. In a dark dark place, shoveling that requires great strength. You must be careful young one.
[空船船員]: 或許你將來會從事挖掘工作。在一個黑暗深邃的地方，進行需要巨大力量的挖掘工作。年輕人，你必須小心。

[Airship Crew]: This type of fortune is never wrong.
[空船船員]: 這種預言從來不會出錯。

[Airship Crew]: The moth is used when it is a caterpillar and ignored after it becomes a moth, by humans.
[空船船員]: 蛾類在化為毛蟲時會被利用，一旦變成蛾子，人類便會忽略它。

[Airship Crew]: Check to see if there is an aspect of your life that is like the moth.
[空船船員]: 請檢查一下，你的生活是否有像蛾子一樣的面向。

[Airship Crew]: The moth flies around without worrying about the future. It is telling you to fly freely rather than getting anxious about the future..
[空船船員]: 蛾子飛翔時不為未來擔憂。它是在告訴你，應該自由飛翔，而非為未來焦慮。

[Airship Crew]: This is the fortune from this card.
[空船船員]: 這是這張牌帶來的預言。

[Airship Crew]: Dustiness' teeth are very strong. This means...
[空船船員]: 塵埃的牙齒非常堅強。這意味著……

[Airship Crew]: To live the future with strong teeth?!
[空船船員]: 要擁有堅牙共度未來嗎？

[Airship Crew]: The moth says that this is not a time to think about wealth and prosperity. It says that someone important has appeared near you.
[空船船員]: 蛾子說，這不是思考財富與繁榮的時候。它表示有人重要的角色即將出現在你身邊。

[Airship Crew]: Any ideas who that may be?
Dustiness symbolizes a hazy future. It is similar to your mind right now. It says it is obvious.
[空船船員]: 塵埃象徵著模糊的未來。這與你當前的心境相似。它表示這是很明顯的。

[Airship Crew]: It says that there is no set path in the future. Isn't a relief in a way?
[空船船員]: 它表示未來沒有固定的路徑。這在某种程度上算是種釋懷吧？

[Airship Crew]: It is not good nor bad, so there is always room for new possibilities.
[空船船員]: 既非好也非壞，因此總有空間產生新的可能性。

[Airship Crew]: Sometime in your future, a future like Dracula awaits you.
[空船船員]: 在某個未來，像德古拉一樣的命運正等著您。

[Airship Crew]: If you hope for that type of future, it is no problem, but you should be careful nonetheless.
[空船船員]: 如果你期待那種未來，沒問題，但還是必須小心。

[Airship Crew]: If the condition is just right, vampires can live forever. But, when that perfect condition is disrupted, they meet a tragic end.
[空船船員]: 如果條件剛好，吸血鬼可以永生。然而，當那完美的條件被破壞時，他們就會遭遇悲劇的結局。

[Airship Crew]: This means that if you go after fame and eternal life, tragedy awaits you in the end. They are not the important things in life.
[空船船員]: 這表示，如果你追求名聲與永生，結局將是悲劇。這些並非生命中最重要的事物。

[Airship Crew]: The Dracula says to be true to the present. Indeed, thinking and being true to the present is much more important than trying to figure out your future.
[空船船員]: 德古拉說，要忠於當下。確實，思考並忠於當下，比試圖推測未來更重要。

[Airship Crew]: Unfortunately, I agree with it young one.
[空船船員]: 不幸的是，我同意您的說法，年輕人。

[Airship Crew]: Pirates do not have a future. That doesn't mean you do not have one. But.. you simply need to make more prudent decisions.
[空船船員]: 海盜沒有未來。這不代表你沒有未來。但……你只需要做出更謹慎的決定。

[Airship Crew]: How about changing your lifestyle? That's what this means.
[空船船員]: 何不改變您的生活型態？這就是它的意義。

[Airship Crew]: In this world, being a pirate out in the rough seas is very dangerous. But, they do not regret their decisions.
[空船船員]: 在這個世界，在風浪中漂泊成為海盜是非常危險的。不過，他們並不後悔自己的決定。

[Airship Crew]: Because they find their meaning of life in the process. Young one, how about searching for the meaning of your life?
[空船船員]: 因為他們在過程中找到了生命的意義。年輕人，何不尋找你生命的意義？

[Airship Crew]: Pirates are remembered as pirates even after they pass away. A person's name is beyond the matter of life and death.
[空船船員]: 海盜即使死後，仍被稱為海盜。人的名字超越了生死。

[Airship Crew]: You should live with that aspect in mind.
[空船船員]: 你應該帶著這種面向來生活。

[Airship Crew]: The Marina does not think of its future.. But I can tell you one thing. Survival. The Marina only thinks about survival and life.
[空船船員]: 瑪麗娜不考慮她的未來……但我可以告訴你一件事。生存。瑪麗娜只關心生存與生命。

[Airship Crew]: You.. no, all of us should learn and do the same.
[空船船員]: 你……不，我們所有人都應該學習並做到這一點。

[Airship Crew]: The Marina doesn't think of its future.. but I can tell you one thing. Freedom. The Marina swims freely.
[空船船員]: 瑪麗娜不考慮她的未來……但我可以告訴你一件事。自由。瑪麗娜自由地游泳。

[Airship Crew]: How about living like that, too?
[空船船員]: 這樣的生活，你也想試試看嗎？

[Airship Crew]: Leave your future to the Marina. The Marina treasures its precious ocean. The sea will be of great significance in your future, too.
[空船船員]: 把你的未來交給瑪麗娜。瑪麗娜珍視她珍貴的大洋。大海在你未來的生活中也將至關重要。

[Airship Crew]: A fisherman? Oceanographer? Pirate? Although I do not know which job it is...
[空船船員]: 漁夫？海洋學家？海盜？雖然我不確定是哪種職業……

[Airship Crew]: A Marionette is a Marionette forever. Its past and future never changes. Its present is its future. Don't you think it is rather sad?
[空船船員]: 馬里奧內特永遠是馬里奧內特。它的過去與未來永不改變。它的當下即是它的未來。你不覺得這相當悲傷嗎？

[Airship Crew]: But that could also be a good thing. This is the meaning of a Marionette.
[空船船員]: 但這也可能是一件好事。這就是馬里奧內特的意義。

[Airship Crew]: A Marionette is restrained but it has hope that it will be freed one day.
[空船船員]: 馬里奧內特雖受束縛，但它仍懷有某天獲得解放的希望。
很好。這份運勢象徵著「希望」。

[Airship Crew]: The eyes of a Marionette symbolize 'challenge.' Challenge will mean a lot in your future.
[空船船員]: 馬里奧內特的眼睛象徵著「挑戰」。挑戰將對你的未來產生重大影響。

[Airship Crew]: ...to the point where that challenge will change your life.
The Marionette believes the present is more important than the future. Basically, asking about the future is pointless.
[空船船員]: 馬里奧內特認為當下比未來更重要。基本上，詢問未來是無意義的。

[Airship Crew]: The Marionette devotes everything into the present. It suggests that type of attitude to you, too.
[空船船員]: 馬里奧內特將一切獻給當下。它也向你建議這種態度。

[Airship Crew]: The Medusa symbolizes the absolute one who accepts everyone's challenge. Your future will be in a position that is challenged by many.
[空船船員]: 梅杜莎象徵著接受眾人挑戰的絕對存在。你的未來將處於眾多挑戰之中。

[Airship Crew]: It could be good and bad. It is also a very tiring position.
[空船船員]: 這或許是好事，或許是壞事。這也是一份非常耗費精力的職責。

[Airship Crew]: The Medusa symbolizes the absolute one who accepts everyone's challenge. Your future must be filled with challenges!
[空船船員]: 梅杜莎象徵著接受眾人挑戰的絕對存在。你的未來必須充滿挑戰！

[Airship Crew]: Always challenge others! It is alright to fail, since challenge itself will become life.
[空船船員]: 總是去挑戰他人吧！失敗無妨，因為挑戰本身即是生命。

[Airship Crew]: The Medusa says that there will be great chaos in the future. Chaos... I'm not sure what type of chaos it means, but it is definitely something that has never happened before.
[空船船員]: 梅杜莎說未來將有大混亂。混沌……我不確定那是哪種混沌，但絕對是前所未見的事。

[Airship Crew]: There is something that you must fight.. and win, in your future.
[空船船員]: 你必須在未來戰鬥……並且勝利。

[Airship Crew]: The hair of the Medusa are sticking up. It is nervous about the big change that is going to happen. A change that even makes the scary Medusa worried.
[空船船員]: 梅杜莎的鬃毛全都豎了起來。她對即將發生的大變動感到緊張。連可怕的梅杜莎也為此擔憂。

[Airship Crew]: How about preparing yourself as well?
The Baphomet doesn't care about a human's future. They simply observe quietly. Hmm... It seems like it has nothing to say about your future as well...
[空船船員]: 巴弗莫特不在乎人的未來。它只是靜靜觀察。嗯……看來它對你的未來也沒什麼可說的……
它帶著一副漠不關心的表情。

[Airship Crew]: The scythe the Baphomet is holding signifies the strong will to conquer the future.
[空船船員]: 巴弗莫特手中的鐮刀，象徵著征服未來的強烈意志。

[Airship Crew]: What you need is not someone else's help or wisdom, but strong willpower.
[空船船員]: 你需要的是他人的幫助或智慧，而是堅定的意志。

[Airship Crew]: Once you have that type of willpower, the road to the future will be very broad and promising.
[空船船員]: 一旦擁有那種意志，通往未來的道路將寬廣而充滿希望。

[Airship Crew]: The Baphomet says that humans have no future. It says that their greed and selfishness shows no hope.
[空船船員]: 巴弗莫特說人類沒有未來。它說人的貪婪與自私毫無希望。

[Airship Crew]: The future will only open to those that go beyond human's greed.
[空船船員]: 唯有超越人類貪婪者，未來才會向他們敞開。

[Airship Crew]: The card expects something like that from you.
[空船船員]: 這張牌正是期待你如此。

[Airship Crew]: The Baphomet is facing the future. No matter how much effort you put in, without an eye that looks towards the future, it is pointless.
[空船船員]: 巴弗莫特正面對未來。無論你付出多少努力，若沒有望向未來的眼睛，皆是徒勞。

[Airship Crew]: The Baphomet is telling you to look towards the future.
[空船船員]: 巴弗莫特正告訴你望向未來。

[Airship Crew]: To know your position right now and where to aim in the future.
[空船船員]: 了解你當下的位置，以及未來的目標所在。

[Airship Crew]: A sand's future is simply sand. Not a rock, nor mud. Some things just don't change young one.
[空船船員]: 沙子的未來只是沙子。既非岩石，亦非泥土。有些事物年輕時便不會改變。

[Airship Crew]: What the Sandman card is trying to say is to treasure your present self.
[空船船員]: 沙人牌試圖告訴你的，是珍惜當下自我。

[Airship Crew]: A sand dune changes its shape even after a day. The Sandman card is speaking of a future with many changes.
[空船船員]: 沙丘即便在一天內也會改變形狀。沙人牌所言的，是充滿變化的未來。

[Airship Crew]: It says not to be too caught up with the present, because the future is always changing.
[空船船員]: 它說不要過度沉迷當下，因為未來永遠在變動。

[Airship Crew]: You will have a son in the future. Hmm? What'd you say? No plans for a baby?
[空船船員]: 你未來會有個兒子。嗯？你說什麼？沒有抱孩子計畫？

[Airship Crew]: That's why it is the future. Unexpected things happen every once in a while in the future. Lala~
[空船船員]: 這就是未來。未來偶爾會發生意想不到的事。啦啦～

[Airship Crew]: There are rare and precious treasures in the sand. The Sandman says that in the vast sand of the world, a treasure, will be discovered. That treasure is you young one.
[空船船員]: 沙中藏有珍貴寶物。沙人說，在這廣闊的沙海中，將發現寶物。那寶物就是你，年輕人。

[Airship Crew]: Do you know what a Sohee thinks the most pitiful thing is? The future. It is because she was not able to live her future.
[空船船員]: 你知道蘇姬認為最可悲的事是什麼嗎？是未來。因為她無法實現自己的未來。

[Airship Crew]: That is why you cannot bring up the subject of future in front of Sohee. I'm very sorry I cannot help.
[空船船員]: 正因如此，你不能在蘇姬面前談論未來。我很抱歉，我無法幫忙。

[Airship Crew]: But isn't it better than a curse. Just think of it as that and forget about it.
[空船船員]: 但這難道不比詛咒好嗎？就當作詛咒吧，然後忘記它。

[Airship Crew]: Even in darkness you will shine for your goal.
[空船船員]: 即使在黑暗中，你也要為目標發光。

[Airship Crew]: The Skeleton is encouraging you to not lose your light even in a life in dark and damp places.
[空船船員]: 骷髏正鼓勵你，即使在黑暗潮濕的地方，也不要失去光芒。

[Airship Crew]: You must feel good, getting a word of encouragement from the Skeleton. Lala~
[空船船員]: 你必須感到開心，能得到骷髏的鼓勵。啦啦～

[Airship Crew]: The story I heard from the skeleton goes like this. I am the king of the future. What in the world is that supposed to mean?
